title: Early direct-DWG renderer and same-family libdxfrw fork screen
scope: Screen newly surfaced open-source DWG/DXF implementations beyond the established parser matrix.
Determine whether their operation, maturity, and implementation lineage add independent parity evidence.
Update optional comparator routing without adding dependencies, fixtures, or support claims.

method.kind: Public project README, version matrix, algorithm notes, and repository metadata review
method.limitations: No peer source tree was pinned or audited; repository self-descriptions and coverage tables are screening evidence only. No peer samples or output were inspected.

sources.name: ft_model repository and README
sources.observed: The project describes a self-developed C++20 DWG/DXF parser and 2D renderer, version families AC1015 through AC1032, a SceneGraph-to-JSON export path, and a test_dwg directory containing real sentinel files. Repository metadata at review time showed 2 stars, one fork, and no releases.

sources.name: ft_model DWG version and fixture status table
sources.observed: The table marks AC1015 as missing/unverified, AC1018/AC1021/AC1032 as partial, and AC1024/AC1027 as implemented; it says missing fixtures must not be treated as version compatibility.

sources.name: ft_model algorithm notes
sources.observed: The R2004+ decompression note labels its LZ77 outline simplified and warns that the actual DWG variant is more complex. The document is project design evidence, not a validated byte-layout reference.

sources.name: ft_model core source manifest
sources.observed: The build lists project-local DWG and DXF parser components and rendering code. This pass did not audit source ancestry or test artifacts, so independent lineage is not certified.

sources.name: codelibs/libdxfrw README
sources.observed: The project describes itself as a fork of the original SourceForge libdxfrw, claims ASCII/Binary DXF and DWG reading through V2015, and advertises added tests and documentation. No pinned source diff or test corpus was audited.

plan_effect.ft_model: Optional 2D rendering/consumer observation only, exact revision and locally authored scratch inputs required if selected; not a DWG/DXF writer, broad semantic witness, or 3D/B-rep oracle.
plan_effect.codelibs_libdxfrw: Same-family fork for independence accounting; optional pinned source/test-idea reference only, not a separate implementation vote.
plan_effect.prohibited_inference: Do not promote a format/version or semantic support claim from project descriptions, incomplete fixture tables, rendered output alone, or a same-family fork.
plan_effect.implementation_change: No new local defect, required comparator, dependency, fixture, CTest, implementation blocker, or validation-cadence change.

repository_state: Plan-only research update in a broadly dirty shared worktree; no source, test, fixture, or dependency change was made by this research pass.
